name: aider
description: Aider, headless. Edits files it is told about, repo map from git. Speaks every provider through litellm; its anthropic route reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_API_BASE, so the provider is Anthropic or any endpoint that serves the Messages shape. No JSON mode: the reporter picks the answer and the usage line out of its text. Resume = restoring the chat history kept in $HOME.
